fallback: Sorry, I didn't understand. Please say it again.
error.EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT: I couldn't hear anything. Please say it again.
error.AUDIO_TOO_SHORT: That was too short. Please say it again.
error.AUDIO_TOO_LONG: Please keep it shorter, under twenty seconds.
error.MISSING_NAME: Whose name? Please say it again with the name.
error.MISSING_AMOUNT: How many rupees? Please say the whole thing again.
error.MISSING_QUANTITY: How much stock? Please say the whole thing again.
error.NOTHING_TO_UNDO: There is no entry to undo.
error.CLARIFICATION_EXPIRED: Time ran out. Please say the whole thing again.
stock_out: Took out {qty} {unit} of {name}. Stock is now {level} {unit}.
advance_paid: Wrote {amount} advance for {name}. {due} is still due this month.
salary_paid: Wrote {amount} salary for {name}. {due} is still due this month.
total.some: {amount} is due in total, from {count} customers.
low.none: All stock is fine, nothing is running low.
staff.head: {name} came in {days} days {when}.
negative_stock: {name} stock is only {level} {unit}. Can't take out that much.
not_found.create: I couldn't find the name {name}. Shall I add a new customer?
not_found: I couldn't find the name {name}. Please say it again.
confirm_amount: {amount} is very large. Should I write it?
staff_list.none: No staff have been added yet.
attendance.none: No one has come in yet today.
attendance.some: {present} came in today. {absent} hasn't come yet.
customers.owing: You have {count} customers, and {owing} owe money.
customers.clear: You have {count} customers, and no one owes anything.
staff_paid.total: {period}, staff were paid {amount}: {advance} advance and {salary} salary.
stock_move.product: {period}, {moved_in} {unit} of {name} came in and {moved_out} {unit} went out.
stock_move.none: {period}, no stock came in or went out.
